label: Build a list
description: Put values together into one list. Declare one input port per item and wire each one: `List(first: String, second: String) -> (list: List[String])` gives `[first, second]`, in the order the ports are written. Declare the list's type on the `list` output, since the items can be of any type. Every port is required like any other, so a branch that closed skips this node instead of handing on a short list. An item that is genuinely optional is written `name?:`, and when nothing arrives on it, it is left out and the items after it move up, so the list never holds a gap or a null that nobody sent.

outputs.name: list
outputs.description: The values of the input ports, in the order the ports are written, leaving out any optional port that received nothing. Declare its type in the source: `-> (list: List[String])`.
